input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return/deletion obligation as Section 17(d)
input.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision: on expiry or termination Garman provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days and then certifies deletion. Our playbook requires a data-return and exit-help obligation; we can accept ninety days of assistance if six months is difficult.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within thirty (30) calendar days of Sparkling's request, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in its possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (3) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.
